verified_with: Release 2.1.289 (its linux-x64 native binary, byte-identical to the one the npm package installs) in PTY runs against a loopback Messages-API stub with a throwaway HOME and CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, a dummy API key, no real credential and no network egress except the first-run preflight: first-run theme, API-key approval and login screens, folder-trust, idle, working (held and streaming reply), idle-after-turn, tool-approval and question screens at widths 20 to 200, terminal-title states, the `claude --version` banner, the SessionStart hook (native reference, resume, fork) and the SubagentStart and SubagentStop hooks registered by pohunek's integration install
